title: math2 skeleton
description: The C2 skeleton of one top-level MSC2020 class, in topics/skeletons/NN.yaml, where NN is the first two characters of the code. It lists the main concepts and definitions of the area, and the theorems that a survey or a graduate text names. Each item has a kind and at least one source. C2 of the class is the share of the items whose node is live and has at least one source. See spec 18.1 and 18.3 in tamnd/math2-agent. A person who works in the area reviews each change of a skeleton in its pull request.

skeleton.description: The top-level code of the class, for example 20-XX. Its first two characters are the name of the file.

sources.description: The sources that the items refer to. The key wikipedia is for the field wikipedia of an item, and each other key is a value of the field mathlib of an item.

decl.description: The Mathlib declaration that states or defines the item, if Mathlib has one.

wikipedia.description: The title of the English Wikipedia article about the item.

wikidata.description: The Wikidata item of the Wikipedia article.

mathlib.description: The Mathlib lists that give the item with the same decl.

node.description: The tag of the node for the item, when the node exists.
